name: mcon_upcoming_birthdays
description: List contacts whose birthday falls within the next `within` days (default 30, max 366), soonest first, computed year-agnostically. Optional `tag` narrows to a group (e.g. 'family'). Each hit has: slug, display_name, month, day, year (may be null), turning_age (null if year unknown), days_until (0 = today). Use this to answer 'whose birthday is coming up' and to drive reminders — e.g. create a Calendar event or a scheduled nudge for each.

tag.description: Optional tag to narrow to. Omit for all.
